cancellation_integration.method: Clean cherry-pick of preview source checkpoint into detached parent worktree; no parent or published branch modification; no cancellation code copied into this main-based PR.

cancellation_integration.limitation: Preflight and serial preview skip remain non-interruptible; only existing surrounding/runner/CMS checkpoints, no latency guarantee.

display.reference: C libjxl normalized RGBA16 + LittleCMS2.16 actual-output-profile to sRGB

benchmark.method: Release resident input, three alternating process pairs, CPU0, three warmups. Median of process medians; timed region covers decode only, full-buffer rolling hash after timing. No other local build/test initiated during the final measurement.
benchmark.limits: Local finite samples only, large managed only5 timed calls/process; not general throughput, zero-overhead or process RSS evidence. Earlier preliminary standalone-lock measurements retained locally; reported values use verified root-lock registry resolutions.

supported_scope: One terminal visible embedded preview structurally scanned and skipped; main-only output in ordinary/EX/CMS APIs. No preview notifications, pixel state or retained preview plane.
Same header/TOC parser, bounds and checked payload extents as main. Fixed preview padded4Mi, global4096-axis and internal4Mi/16384-axis/4096TOC/64main-layer caps unchanged.
Caller pixels/frames/animation_bytes describe main canvas; codec sample guard also covers independently bounded preview dimensions.
No new public key, extraction/information API, channel model, jxl version, merge, release or issue closure.
deferred_or_limits: Non-visible/non-terminal preview sequences refused because pinned codec would use SkipOutput and construct pixel state.
Skipped entropy is opaque; independent C main-only skips identical damaged data while requesting preview fails.
No preview extraction API; pinned codec has preview decoding but WML2 needs a separate dimensions/layout/colour/limit contract.
Oversized declaration fixture is header-admission negative with a small body, not a claimed valid oversized-pixel encoding.
Known-buffer/request admission, not all allocator/callback details or process RSS.
Existing documentation/cancellation/brob/structured metadata branches remain separate; reconcile current support/harness counts when integrating.
